thread:
oncall-bot: Paging: elevated latency and 5xxs on embeddings-route in us-east-1 (detected by perf-alert-embeds)

maria: seeing customer errors + timeouts, spikes started ~2m ago. dashboards show QPS jump ~6x.

cheng: looking at infra now. can someone confirm if any deploys landed in last 10m?

deploy-bot: deploy:service/webhook v2.1.9 promoted to prod 3m ago (by ryan). no other infra deploys.

ryan: I pushed a small model-selector tweak 4m ago but shouldn't touch embeddings route. rolling back if needed.

maria: traffic map shows embed-heavy tenant slices driving most of increase. chat routes stable.

cheng: ok — plan: 1) carve back QPS for the hot tenant slice on embeddings-route, 2) enable rerank-disable flag for affected tenants, 3) route fallback to lower-cost embed model.

ryan: I can run the carve. using admin CLI: ```rbctl quota update --route "embeddings-route" --tenant-slice "slice-42" --qps 25 --reason "live spike"```

maria: +1. roll it now. tag me.

ryan: running now...

deploy-bot: exec: rbctl quota update --route "embeddings-route" --tenant-slice "slice-42" --qps 25 --reason "live spike"

ryan: done. API responded 200. watching metrics.

cheng: I also toggled rerank for slice-42: feature-flag disabled (ff-off) to avoid extra calls. command: `ffctl set rerank slice-42 off`

maria: evidence so far: 30s after carve, p50 latency down ~25%, 5xxs reduced but still above baseline for that slice.

sophie: CS update: customer "Acme" saw degraded embeddings scoring; they've paused heavy jobs and want ETA. I told them we're mitigating and will follow up.

cheng: next step if this holds: move slice-42 to fallback model variant (quantized) to reduce token compute. can do seamless model switch on routing layer.

ryan: prep command to switch route variant: ```rbctl route set-variant embeddings-route slice-42 model:open-embed-quant-v2``` need approval?

maria: go ahead if metrics plateau >2m.

ryan: executing model switch now.

deploy-bot: exec: rbctl route set-variant embeddings-route slice-42 model:open-embed-quant-v2

ryan: switch applied. traffic gradually moving. p99 is improving.

maria: overall impact: customer-facing latency for embeddings falling; chat unaffected. we still have a minority of 503s for long sequences.

cheng: enabling temporary QPS cap on global embeddings route to protect system: ```rbctl quota update --route "embeddings-route" --qps 400 --global```. doing it now.

ryan: global cap applied. dashboards show total QPS down to expected.

maria: can we re-enable rerank for unaffected slices? we disabled broadly earlier but want to be surgical.

cheng: switching rerank back for slices not flagged: `ffctl set rerank --only-slices default,true`

maria: done. Sophie can tell Acme we expect stabilization in 10-20m and we will follow with post-incident notes.

sophie: relaying to Acme now. thanks.

ryan: logging mitigation steps to incident ticket INC-2026-987: quota carve, rerank toggle, model fallback, global cap.

oncall-bot: severity updated to P2 -> monitoring.

maria: handoff to eve for overnight watch. summary: spike from tenant slice-42 caused embeddings QPS surge; mitigations applied: slice QPS carve to 25, rerank toggled off for slice-42 then re-enabled for safe slices, slice moved to quantized fallback model, global embeddings QPS cap 400. customer "Acme" informed. residual 503s for long sequences — investigating potential tokenization edge case.

eve: taking handoff. I have access to rbctl and ffctl. will keep watch for 2h and escalate to infra if 503 persists.

maria: thanks, eve. attaching dump of alert graph and short runbook steps.

cheng: adding note: consider longer term: add automatic soft-quotas per-tenant based on historical percentiles to avoid single-tenant blasts. filing follow-up RFC.

eve: ack. will update incident ticket with timeline and handoff notes.

sophie: customer ack: "thanks for quick response — we'll resume jobs after you confirm stability."

maria: closing thread here. please update INC ticket with any postmortem items. :thumbsup:
